name: jira_create
description: Creates one new Jira issue in a project assigned to this assistant, with a summary and optionally a description, labels and a parent epic or story. Use it only after the user has confirmed the project, type and summary. It does not change an existing issue (use jira_transition, jira_comment or jira_link). Calling it twice creates two issues, so never repeat a call that succeeded. Returns one line with the new key. If the project, type or summary is missing, ask; do not assume it.

project.description: Project key the issue goes in (e.g. PROJ).

type.description: Issue type name as the project uses it (e.g. Task, Bug, Story).

summary.description: One-line title the user approved (e.g. Fix login timeout).

description.description: Plain text body; blank lines separate paragraphs. Leave it out for none.

labels.description: Labels separated by commas (e.g. backend,urgent). Leave it out for none.

parent.description: Key of the parent epic or story (e.g. PROJ-100). Leave it out for none.
